releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 1.0.1 (the living island update)

- BLOOD MOON: every 3rd night the sky turns red. Trees come out in force and hit harder, but logs, chests and fishing all pay double. Survive until dawn for a bonus.
- GHOST LUMBERJACKS are real now: they float out into the woods, chop trees, and pay you cash for every one they fell.
- FISHING: press F at the pond, on any beach or on the ferry dock. Time the reel in the green zone, catch 20+ species (rarer at night, in the rain and on a blood moon), sell them to the Reaper, and fill your Fish Journal (J). New shop item: Better Fishing Rod.
- WEATHER: clear skies, clouds, rain, thunderstorms with lightning, and thick fog roll across the island.
- A LIVING ISLAND: deer, rabbits, crabs, seagulls, frogs, birds and butterflies. Fish jump in the pond, chimneys smoke, flowers and tall grass fill the meadows, clouds drift by, and the sea has shallows and a foamy shore.
- New sounds: surf, rain, birdsong, crickets, frogs and footsteps.
